title: Update Metrics
source_docs: Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox/Incremental Learning/Update_Metrics.md
text: Update performance metrics in incremental learning model given new data, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Metrics data type} sets Data type of metrics output; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental learning, {Model performance metrics to track} sets the performance metrics function, {Add input port for observation weights} adds second input port for observation, {Add input port for resetting trained learner} adds input port for resetting trained incremental, {Predictor data observation dimension} sets the observation dimension of predictor data, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Metrics data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of metrics for range checking, {Metrics data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of metrics for range checking, {Predict response data type} sets the data type of predict response Inherit, {Predict response data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of predict response for range checking, {Predict response data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of predict response for range checking, {Loss data type} sets the data type of loss output Inherit, {Loss data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of loss for range checking, {Loss data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of loss for range checking, {Additional predict data type}, {Additional predict data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of additional predict for range checking, {Additional loss data type}, {Additional loss data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of additional loss for range checking and {Additional loss data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of additional loss for range checking. Values come from the instance.
